page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number "32" at the top left. A full-width heading (Articulus XIII) sits below the body text, followed by the first paragraph of the next article. No margin notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: hostes, qui Ecclesiæ & singulis ipsius membris tanquam prædones è speculâ omnibus viribus insidiantur, ut imposturis suis ac deceptionibus omnia destruant atque pessundent: [atque adeò quidem ut se adorari ab omnibus velint, quem in finem multa hominibus pollicentur: neque mirum hoc est, cum Diabolus Christum ausus fuerit aggredi, eumq; permovere ut ipsum adoraret. ] Idcirco propriâ suâ malitiâ perpetuæ condemnationi addicti, expectant indies horrenda suorum facinorum supplicia ac tormenta. Respuimus itaque atque execramur hoc loco Saducæorum errorem, qui Spiritus ullos aut Angelos esse negarunt. Item & Manichæorum errorem, qui asserunt Diabolos ex seipsis originem ducere, & ex propriâ suâ naturâ malos esse: non autem corruptos per inobedientiam voluntariam.
main_text.head: ARTICULUS XIII. De Providentiâ Dei.
main_text.p: Credimus Deum hunc Opt.Max. post-quam res omnes creasset, eas minimè sortis[?]

page.notes: The last word "sortis" has a long-s/f shape that is hard to tell apart; read as "sortis" with [?]. Bracketed passage "[atque adeò ... adoraret. ]" is printed with brackets, copied as printed. Hyphenated line-end words kept with their printed hyphens (mem-bris, pessun-dent, ho-minibus, aggre-di, de-ceptionibus, con-demnationi, Diabo-los, hor-renda, post-quam). The heading "ARTICVLVS" is given as ARTICULUS by the u/v rule.
